run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit completed over all namespaces whose name starts with 'app-283'. The cluster held exactly four such namespaces at query time (out of 11 namespaces total): app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search. In every one of the four, the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' exists and carries an 'audit_code' key (each ConfigMap's data keys were audit_code, owner, tier). The audited values are: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q; app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V; app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z; app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. No namespace with the app-283 prefix was missing the ConfigMap or the key. All readings are the cluster's object state at the moment of the query (observed 2026-11-23T19:15:45Z to 2026-11-23T19:15:50Z), so they describe the current configuration, not the configuration at any earlier point in the authorized window. No fault, alert or anomaly was involved in this task, so no root cause is named.

metadata.managedFieldsSummary was not read for these ConfigMaps, so the manager and time of the last write to audit_code are unknown.
next_steps: If historical audit_code values matter, re-run the audit against a recorded cluster snapshot or enable a change-history source; the current toolset only exposes live object state.
